title: Bernard A NDE 8274
content: It was Thanksgiving night and I was walking to a party. A car pull up along the side of me and a mask guy got out. The only thing I could see was his blue eyes as he put the gun to my head for about thirty seconds. I told him, 'if you're gonna shoot, go ahead. What you waiting for.' Then all I see is the fire from the barrel of the gun. I didn't feel my body hit the ground. All I know was that I was back in front of my house standing on the porch. It was dark and so quiet. Never in my life had I seen and then heard a little girl's voice from across the street. It was like she was in my head telling me, 'Daddy let's go home now. I said, 'no.' She said it again, 'Daddy let's go home.' I said, 'no' again. She said, 'Daddy let's go home,' for a third time. I replied, 'No. I was back in my body the guy was still standing above me and shooting me. He ran to the car and got in. He looked back at me. I could see it in his eyes as I was raising up looking back at him. He shot at me one more time and drove off. I believe someone divine was wathcing over me. The doctors couldn't believe how the bullets were curving around my neck, missing my throat, spine, and head.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Standing on the porch in front of his house after being shot.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reports not feeling his body hit the ground.

arrival.other_being_detail: A little girl's voice from across the street, experienced as 'in my head,' calling him 'Daddy' and urging him to 'go home.'

environment.environment_other_detail: He was 'back in front of my house standing on the porch. It was dark and so quiet.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot at close range (gun to head) by an assailant on Thanksgiving night.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reports being back on his porch and hearing a little girl's voice 'in my head' urging him to 'go home now,' which he refuses three times before returning to his body while the shooter is still present.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE to a familiar location (his porch) with internal communication urging return, then immediate return to the body during the ongoing shooting; no tunnel/light/life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Instead of a tunnel or otherworldly realm, he reports appearing on his own porch in darkness/quiet and hearing a little girl's voice 'in my head' calling him 'Daddy' and telling him to go home; he refuses three times before returning to his body.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Daddy let's go home now.” / “Daddy let's go home.” / “if you're gonna shoot, go ahead. What you waiting for.”
